title: Psalm 19
content:
May the Lord hear you in the day of distress;* may the name of the God of Jacob defend you.
May He send you help from the sanctuary* and from Zion may He sustain you.
May He remember all your sacrifices,* and may your whole burnt offering be honored.
May He give you what your heart desires* and fulfill all your plans.
We shall rejoice in your salvation* and in the name of our God we shall be great.
May the Lord fulfill all your petitions.* Now I know that the Lord has saved His anointed.
He will hear him from His holy heaven;* in His right hand is the power of salvation.
Some trust in chariots and some in horses,* but we will call upon the name of the Lord our God.
They have collapsed and fallen,* but we have risen and stand upright.
O Lord, save the king* and hear us on the day we call upon You.
